title: Missing Flight and Partner Activity Claims in the Summit Program
content:
A Crestline Summit Loyalty Program member may claim a Crestline flight that did not post, usually because the Summit number was missing from the booking or the name did not match.

### Conditions for a missing Crestline flight

1. **Flown coupon and matching name.** A missing flight can be claimed only on a ticket whose coupon for that segment has been flown and whose passenger name matches the member's profile name. The ticket's own record decides both points.
2. **Claim window.** A missing Crestline flight can be claimed no later than the flight date of the missing flight plus the retro credit window days of the member's tier. The window is counted in calendar days from the flight date of the coupon, and a claim on the last day is accepted.
3. **Waiting period.** A claim is also not accepted until the tier's minimum days after the flight have passed, counted in calendar days after the flight date, because automatic posting may still complete.
4. **Once only.** Each flown segment is credited once; a segment already credited by flight accrual or retro credit, identified by its ticket and segment number, is never credited again.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, a 270-day window)

| Flight date | Claim date | Within the window |
|---|---|---|
| 1 March 2025 | 26 November 2025 (day 270, the last day) | Yes |
| 1 March 2025 | 27 November 2025 (day 271) | No |

With a 365-day window the same flight could be claimed through 1 March 2026.

### What the retro credit posts

The former clause "The retro credit earns exactly what the flight would have earned on its flight date under the flight-earning rule, at the tier held on that date" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the miles a retro credit carries and for the qualifying dollars a retro-credited segment posts.

A retro credit posts qualifying dollars to the current calendar year only when the flight date falls in the current calendar year.

### Missing partner activity

Missing partner activity is claimed within the partner claim window days of the partner activity date, and is posted as a partner accrual carrying the partner's own partner reference.

superseded_clauses: The retro credit earns exactly what the flight would have earned on its flight_date under the flight-earning rule, at the tier held on that date
